reviews.name: Stephanie Perez
reviews.text: Best dental experience I’ve had! The staff is amazing and Dr. Sean is easy to talk to and thorough in his approach. I have bad anxiety about the dentist and the staff made sure to make me feel at ease and comfortable. Lucia at the front desk is absolutely AMAZING! She’s so sweet and knowledgeable. I love her! Grateful to have found this practice.

reviews.name: Tracy Tran
reviews.text: I came to see Dr. Sean at Legacy Dental for some involved dental work and immediately felt confident in his impressive training and experience. He took the appropriate diagnostic X-rays and thoroughly treatment planned my case. We quickly moved forward with extracting an infected tooth followed by a well thought out implant plan. Throughout the entire process, he has been incredibly patient, comprehensive, and attentive. He even reached out to me the day after the check on how I was feeling. The office itself is extremely modern, welcoming, and even has some fun goodies that make the experience more enjoyable. I highly recommend this office and genuinely look forward to coming back.

reviews.name: Valerie Delos Angeles
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience at Legacy Dental from start to finish! My dental cleaning was incredibly thorough, and Lucian, the hygienist was exceptional. He was meticulous, gentle, and highly knowledgeable, taking the time to explain everything while making me feel completely comfortable throughout the appointment. His friendly, personable approach made what is usually a routine visit genuinely pleasant. I also had a resin infiltration procedure performed by Dr. Sean and I couldn't be happier with the results. Dr. Sean was professional, skilled, and attentive, ensuring I understood the process and felt confident every step of the way. The outcome exceeded my expectations. The entire team was welcoming, accommodating, and committed to providing outstanding patient care. It's clear that everyone in the office genuinely cares about their patients' comfort and overall experience. I highly recommend this practice to anyone seeking exceptional dental care.

reviews.name: Leslie Mora
reviews.text: Dr. Sean and Dr. Cho make a great team! They took their time explaining what my ideal treatment should be. I needed a crown and they were able to make me the permanent one the same visit. Extremely grateful that they were able to see me in such short notice!
